config.label: Clickwise API key, optional
config.description: Clickwise API key, optional. Program discovery, deals, catalog stats and tracked links work without it. Product search and GTIN lookup work with a free 14-day sandbox key that needs no account, from the Developers page (websiteUrl). Feeds, your links and reports need your publisher key.

config.label: Merchant Bearer token, optional
config.description: Merchant Bearer token, optional. Only the merchant tools that say "Merchant Bearer token required" use it: tracking test link, conversions key, integration status and results. The account gets it once, from get_merchant_credentials.
